# Keep first address-pill spacing when moving input padding

The D209916 reviewer asked for margin-inline:4px 0 on the address container and later requested a first-child rule for the first pill instead of changing every pill’s end margin. The accepted CSS keeps .address-pill margin-inline-end:3px and adds &:first-child { margin-inline-start:4px; }. It uses logical inline/block properties in shared and platform stylesheets. The patch author said only Linux had been tested during review, so the accepted layout is not evidence of a cross-platform visual test. The current checkout retains these spacing rules.

Scope: Compose addressing CSS.

Paths:

- `mail/themes/shared/mail/messengercompose.css`

## Evidence

[Shared lesson record](../records/2885d97931b269cd4dd7ef8b8298a6ea0fe75e0d71aa00c0a4ee719717a9e96e.json).

~~~
